file_stem: RWB E1 035 Case record view v1 1 with documents and history timeline
title: Case record view v1.1 with documents and history timeline
goal: One timeline of contacts, documents, assignments, transfers and status changes, with who or which rule
why: 'Why is this case here?' gets one answer. Rule-caused events show their rule ID and version; manual ones show the person and reason.
triggers: Case owner opens the Timeline panel
ace_note: No ACE read here. ACE contact history is shown in the record view (E1-023); this panel reads Workbench sources.
stores: None. Each section times out at 3,000 ms (caserecord.section.timeout.ms).

functions.name: TimelineItemMapper
functions.does: puts rule + version or person in 'by'

rules: BR1: time order; ties go decision, status, assignment, transfer, contact, document
BR2: rule-caused events show the rule ID and version
BR3: a manual transfer shows its reason
BR6: under 2 s at the 2031 ledger size (NFR-070)
risks: Decision log query does not answer -> other sections shown + section message (MSG-P3-023)
